method.what: SSO's All techniques Long (UACC CC32 = 1) against CC1, every 3 semitones over the Long's sounding range (sso_sound_range.json), plus each patch's test pitch (sso_sound_dynamics.json's pitch): the 15 patches that had no section level before 2026-10-15 (section_balance_cl.py GAP; real_range.py GAP_OWN / GAP_FAMILY): Solo Violin 1 / 2, Solo Viola, Solo Cello, Motif Horns a4, Motif Trumpets a3, Motif Trombones a5, Piccolo, Alto Flute, Bass Flute, Contrabass Clarinet, Contrabass Trombone, Cimbasso Solo, Cimbassi a2, Contrabass Tuba
method.measured: 2026-10-15 on the Windows 11 test VM, the real Spitfire Symphony Orchestra in Kontakt Player 8.13.1 (VST 3), offline, by the VM's test host kthost (MD5 ea7e692e; one process per patch, so one transport start each, 44.1 kHz stereo float, 512-frame blocks split at each event as MuseScore does), as sso_winds_cc1_curves.json
method.setups: the setups MuseScore made from each patch's .nki (maker 2, $iooxo=3), resaved by Kontakt, unedited: the VM's background dynamics check setups (the first eleven), the rest check's for Contrabass Trombone, Cimbasso Solo, Cimbassi a2 and Contrabass Tuba (made the same way 2026-09-30): the library's defaults
method.events: as sso_cc1_curves.json: CC32 1 and CC11 127 once; a warm-up note (not measured); then per pitch, per CC1 value, 4 notes in a row, held 3.0 s, 1.5 s apart, velocity = CC1, CC1 sent 1 s before its note-on
method.takes: 4 per point: the solo strings and the Motif patches play one sample per point (all four takes identical); the other eight alternate two round robins (rmsDbTakes A B A B; A - B median 0.7-1.5 dB per patch, up to 11.6 dB at one point: Bass Flute), so the median is the two round robins' mean

measures.rmsDb: mean power of both channels 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, dB full scale
measures.lufs: ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated loudness (pyloudnorm) of the note-on to the note-off, LUFS
measures.sones: ISO 532-1 stationary loudness (mosqito loudness_zwst, free field) of the mid channel 1.5-3.0 s after the note-on, samples as pascals: only ratios mean anything
measures.loudDb: the dynamics check's measure: the loudest 50 ms (25 ms hop) of the note and 0.5 s of its release
measures.loud1sDb: the same over the note's first 1.0 s and 0.5 s more

method.points: per pitch, per CC1: the median of the 4 takes and their spread (max - min); rmsDbTakes each take's rmsDb in the order played
method.relative64: per measure: [cc, median over pitches of (value - value at CC1 64; sones: ratio), min, max, pitches, median repeat spread, largest repeat spread]
